000465: 	{

000203: 		float nearClipPlane = camera.nearClipPlane;
000204: 		float farClipPlane = camera.farClipPlane;
000205: 		float fieldOfView = camera.fieldOfView;
000206: 		float aspect = camera.aspect;
000207: 		Matrix4x4 identity = Matrix4x4.identity;
000208: 		float num = fieldOfView * 0.5f;
000209: 		Vector3 vector = camera.transform.right * nearClipPlane * Mathf.Tan(num * (MathF.PI / 180f)) * aspect;
000210: 		Vector3 vector2 = camera.transform.up * nearClipPlane * Mathf.Tan(num * (MathF.PI / 180f));
000211: 		Vector3 vector3 = camera.transform.forward * nearClipPlane - vector + vector2;

000705: 	private bool FindSuitableTranslatePoint(Collider hit, out Vector3 translatePoint)
000706: 	{
000707: 		CharacterController component = hit.GetComponent<CharacterController>();
000708: 		Vector3 vector = hit.transform.position + (component.bounds.size.y - component.radius) * 1.5f * Vector3.up;
000709: 		Vector3 vector2 = hit.transform.position + (component.bounds.size.y + component.radius) * 0.5f * Vector3.up;
000710: 		LayerMask physicsLayerMask = GetPhysicsLayerMask(Layers.PLAYER);
000711: 		physicsLayerMask = (int)physicsLayerMask ^ LayerMask.GetMask(LayerMask.LayerToName(Layers.PLAYER));
000712: 		Collider[] array = Physics.OverlapCapsule(vector, vector2, component.radius, physicsLayerMask);
000713: 		if (array.Length == 0)
000714: 		{
000715: 			translatePoint = Vector3.up;
000716: 			return true;
000717: 		}
000718: 		for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
000719: 		{

000705: 	private bool FindSuitableTranslatePoint(Collider hit, out Vector3 translatePoint)
000706: 	{
000707: 		CharacterController component = hit.GetComponent<CharacterController>();
000708: 		Vector3 vector = hit.transform.position + (component.bounds.size.y - component.radius) * 1.5f * Vector3.up;
000709: 		Vector3 vector2 = hit.transform.position + (component.bounds.size.y + component.radius) * 0.5f * Vector3.up;
000710: 		LayerMask physicsLayerMask = GetPhysicsLayerMask(Layers.PLAYER);
000711: 		physicsLayerMask = (int)physicsLayerMask ^ LayerMask.GetMask(LayerMask.LayerToName(Layers.PLAYER));
000712: 		Collider[] array = Physics.OverlapCapsule(vector, vector2, component.radius, physicsLayerMask);
000713: 		if (array.Length == 0)
000714: 		{
000715: 			translatePoint = Vector3.up;
000716: 			return true;
000717: 		}
000718: 		for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
000719: 		{
000720: 			for (int j = -1; j < 2; j++)
000721: 			{
000722: 				for (int k = -1; k < 2; k++)
000723: 				{
000724: 					Vector3 vector3 = new Vector3(j, 0f, k);
000725: 					if (!Physics.CheckCapsule(vector + vector3, vector2 + vector3, component.radius, physicsLayerMask))
000726: 					{
000727: 						translatePoint = Vector3.up + vector3;
000728: 						return true;
000729: 					}
000730: 				}
000731: 			}
000732: 		}
000733: 		translatePoint = Vector3.zero;
000734: 		return false;
000735: 	}

000688: 	{

000690: 		int index = 0;

000692: 		while (!stop)

000081: 	public void UpdateForces(Rigidbody body)
000082: 	{
000083: 		if (Ocean.Instance == null)
000084: 		{
000085: 			BuoyantForce = Vector3.zero;
000086: 			DragForce = Vector3.zero;

000088: 			return;

000090: 		Vector3 position = transform.position;
000091: 		WaterHeight = Ocean.Instance.QueryWaves(position.x, position.z);
000092: 		CalculateSubmersion(radius, position.y);
000093: 		float unitScale = GetUnitScale();
000094: 		float num = DENSITY_WATER * unitScale * SubmergedVolume;
000095: 		BuoyantForce = Physics.gravity * (0f - num);
000096: 		Vector3 velocity = body.velocity;
000097: 		float magnitude = velocity.magnitude;
000098: 		velocity = velocity.normalized * magnitude * magnitude * -1f;
000099: 		DragForce = 0.5f * dragCoefficient * DENSITY_WATER * unitScale * SubmergedVolume * velocity;
000100: 		Stickyness = Vector3.up * (WaterHeight - position.y) * Mass * stickyness;
000101: 	}

000103: 	private void CalculateSubmersion(float r, float y)
000104: 	{
000105: 		float num = WaterHeight - (y - radius);
000106: 		float num2 = 2f * r - num;
000107: 		if (num2 <= 0f)
000108: 		{
000109: 			SubmergedVolume = Volume;
000110: 			return;
000111: 		}
000112: 		if (num2 > 2f * r)
000113: 		{
000114: 			SubmergedVolume = 0f;
000115: 			return;
000116: 		}
000117: 		float num3 = Mathf.Sqrt(num * num2);
000118: 		SubmergedVolume = MathF.PI / 6f * num * (3f * num3 * num3 + num * num);

000008: 	public static float[] CreateHeightMap(Terrain terrain)
000009: 	{

000011: 		int heightmapResolution = terrainData.heightmapResolution;
000012: 		Vector3 heightmapScale = terrainData.heightmapScale;
000013: 		float[,] heights = terrainData.GetHeights(0, 0, heightmapResolution, heightmapResolution);
000014: 		float[] array = new float[heightmapResolution * heightmapResolution];

000016: 		{
000017: 			for (int j = 0; j < heightmapResolution; j++)
000018: 			{

000020: 			}
000021: 		}
000022: 		return array;
000023: 	}

000838: 	private float Spring(float start, float end, float value)
000839: 	{
000840: 		value = Mathf.Clamp01(value);
000841: 		value = (Mathf.Sin(value * MathF.PI * (0.2f + 2.5f * value * value * value)) * Mathf.Pow(1f - value, 2.2f) + value) * (1f + 1.2f * (1f - value));
000842: 		return start + (end - start) * value;
000843: 	}

000841: 		value = (Mathf.Sin(value * MathF.PI * (0.2f + 2.5f * value * value * value)) * Mathf.Pow(1f - value, 2.2f) + value) * (1f + 1.2f * (1f - value));
000842: 		return start + (end - start) * value;
000843: 	}
000844: 
000845: 	private Vector3 SpringVector(Vector3 from, Vector3 to, float time)
000846: 	{
000847: 		return new Vector3(Spring(from.x, to.x, time), Spring(from.y, to.y, time), Spring(from.z, to.z, time));
000848: 	}
000849: }

000909: 	private static void OrderByFurthestFromPoint(SaveablePrefab[] arr, Vector3 point)
000910: 	{
000911: 		for (int i = 0; i < arr.Length - 1; i++)
000912: 		{
000913: 			for (int j = i + 1; j < arr.Length; j++)
000914: 			{
000915: 				SaveablePrefab saveablePrefab = arr[i];
000916: 				SaveablePrefab saveablePrefab2 = arr[j];
000917: 				if (saveablePrefab.CanReorder && saveablePrefab2.CanReorder)
000918: 				{
000919: 					float sqrMagnitude = (point - saveablePrefab.transform.position).sqrMagnitude;
000920: 					float sqrMagnitude2 = (point - saveablePrefab2.transform.position).sqrMagnitude;

000065: 			}
000066: 		}

000071: 		}
000072: 		float num = Mathf.Sin(sine) * breatheMagnitude * scale;
000073: 		Vector3 vector2 = transform.up * num;
000074: 		body.transform.position = transform.position + vector2;
